positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Platform Developer for Vivint Smart Home

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented new product features for IoT equipment such as cameras, radar systems, door locks, tank sensors and more.
• Created a video management server using Javascript that reads RTSP streams from IP cameras and makes the video available for live and historical playback.
• Created a map on the front-end that visualizes radar equipment tracking moving objects.
• Setup the first front-end unit tests on a large Javascript application.
• Integrated SDK services of Milestone and Genetec video management systems into platform using C#.
• Refactored large portions of Angular.js code according to recommended styles.
• Overcame challenges of working remotely full-time since June 2018.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Utilized Amazon Lamba to run a Node.js script that handled a stream of events from Kinesis and direct them to Mailgun.
• Fixed bugs in company mobile app using Javascript based app maker Titanium.
• Designed and implemented new features on multiple company websites using Angular.js
• Trained in and used Agile methodology such as sprint planning meetings, scrums, code reviews, and continuous integration.
• Hosted a fun hackathon where participants created artificial intelligence using Node.js to maneuver tanks in a capture the flag game that I created from scratch. I received special recognition from CTO for hosting.

• Collaborated on Angular.js website for Adobe.

projects.title: SMS Attendance Tracker
projects.description: SMS Attendance Tracker is an application I developed that tracks classroom attendance using SMS messaging and displays attendance using google spreadsheets.  This app allows attendees to text the word of the day to a Twillio number.  Twillio then pushes the message to a Node server that stores the number, registered name and date in a Mongo database.  I then created a Google Apps Script script to get data from the Mongo database in order to format and display the data in a coherent way.  It worked perfectly in the four months it was used.

projects.title: OpenCV FFmpeg HLS Video Management System
projects.description:
Video management system that uses openCV, FFmpeg, and HLS. Written in Node, Javascript and Python

Combines OpenCV, FFmpeg and HLS using Javascript and Python
Streams RTSP video from cameras using FFmpeg
Sends images from stream to OpenCV to do pedestrian detection
Superimposed detection areas in stream HLS stream
Saves HLS streams for historical playback
